title: Scalar cup agrees with ordinary module cup
statement: The scalar Ext cup in bidegree (p,q) equals (-1)^(p*q) times any ordinary module cup characterized by the unsigned sectionwise pairing on all module cup resolution data. This holds for every field, scheme over the field, coefficient modules, degrees, and classes. Definitions and comparison data: [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations], [def-sc-module-cohomology-cup-product], [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap].

proof.text: Choose a cup resolution pairing. Surjectivity of the computing class maps gives representatives a and b. Leibniz shows that their paired section is a cycle c. Apply the signed resolution comparison, then replace the target class by the prescribed cup using hcup. The integer factor (-1)^(p*q) is retained.

proof_origin.place: K1, 2026-10-15: signed resolution comparison, cochain shift interchange, and tensor-homology summand normalization. Cohomology Tags 01F7, 0FKV; Varieties Tag 0BED.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarCup_moduleCup_compatibility
    {k : Type w} [Field k] {X : Scheme.{w}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (F G : X.Modules) (p q : ℕ)
    (cup : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace q).obj G →ₗ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
      (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace (p + q)).obj
        (@id X.Modules (F ⊗ G)))
    (hcup :
      ∀ (D : CupResolutionPairing F G)
        (a : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.left.K).sc p).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (b : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.right.K).sc q).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K)
        (c : ((((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj D.target.K).sc (p + q)).moduleCatLeftHomologyData.K),
        c.val = D.pair p q ⊤ a.val b.val →
          cup (D.left.class p a) (D.right.class q b) = D.target.class (p + q) c)
    (a : scalarCohomology f F p) (b : scalarCohomology f G q) :
    scalarCohomologyCup f F G p q a b =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (p * q) • cup a b
